### **About the Position**

#### **Introduction**


Werfen è un'azienda innovativa a conduzione familiare, fondata nel 1966 a Barcellona, in Spagna. Siamo leader mondiale nella diagnostica specializzata nei settori di Emostasi, Acute Care Diagnotics, Medicina Trasfusionale, Autoimmunità e Medicina dei Trapianti. Attraverso la nostra linea di business Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM), ricerchiamo, sviluppiamo e produciamo test e biomateriali personalizzati. Operiamo direttamente in 30 paesi e in oltre 100 territori attraverso distributori. La nostra sede centrale e i nostri centri tecnologici si trovano in Europa e negli Stati Uniti e la nostra azienda conta più di 7\.000 collaboratori.


#### **Overview**


Entrando in Werfen come EU Regulatory Affairs Manager, avrai un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo e nell’attuazione della strategia regolatoria europea per i prodotti IVD per i quali l’entità legale italiana opera come fabbricante legale o rappresentante autorizzato europeo.


Collaborerai con i Technology Center e con le funzioni Quality Assurance \& Regulatory delle affiliate europee, assicurando che la documentazione tecnica, le registrazioni in EUDAMED e le attività svolte durante l’intero ciclo di vita dei prodotti siano conformi ai requisiti europei.


Sarai inoltre un punto di riferimento per gli stakeholder regolatori interni ed esterni, rappresentando Werfen presso autorità competenti, organismi notificati, associazioni di settore e gruppi di lavoro europei.


#### **Responsibilities**


* Supportare i Technology Center nello sviluppo della strategia regolatoria europea per i prodotti IVD.
* Operare come Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance, in conformità all’IVDR, per i prodotti per i quali l’entità legale italiana è il rappresentante autorizzato europeo.
* Supervisionare la conformità alle normative europee e le registrazioni dei prodotti IVD in EUDAMED.
* Coordinare gli audit dei Technical File, assicurandone completezza e conformità ai requisiti europei.
* Supportare i team Regulatory delle affiliate europee e i distributori nella gestione della documentazione.
* Supervisionare l’esecuzione e il monitoraggio delle attività di vigilanza e delle field action in Europa.
* Definire e monitorare KPI in grado di rappresentare le attività e il valore generato dalla funzione.
* Rappresentare Werfen presso associazioni di categoria, organismi di rappresentanza regolatoria e forum di settore.
* Costruire e mantenere relazioni con autorità competenti, organismi notificati e altri stakeholder regolatori europei.
* Monitorare l’evoluzione della normativa europea, comunicandone internamente gli impatti e supportando la preparazione agli audit delle autorità regolatorie.
* Guidare e sviluppare il team Regulatory, promuovendo una cultura collaborativa e orientata alle soluzioni.
* Consolidare la collaborazione con i referenti Regulatory delle affiliate europee e dei distributori.

#### **Qualifications**


**Chi stiamo cercando**


Cerchiamo una persona con una solida esperienza nel Regulatory Affairs applicato ai dispositivi diagnostici in vitro, capace di muoversi con autorevolezza in contesti multinazionali e in scenari regolatori complessi.


La persona ideale combina una conoscenza approfondita della normativa europea con capacità di coordinamento, visione strategica e un approccio fortemente collaborativo. È in grado di costruire relazioni efficaci con interlocutori interni ed esterni e di tradurre l’evoluzione normativa in indicazioni concrete a supporto del business.

**Requisiti**

**Formazione**

* Laurea triennale o magistrale in Life Sciences, Ingegneria, Regulatory Affairs o discipline affini.

**Esperienza**

* Esperienza maturata nel Regulatory Affairs relativo ai dispositivi IVD.
* Esperienza nel coordinamento di attività regolatorie a livello europeo.
* Esperienza nella gestione di Technical File conformi all’EU IVDR o di Summary Technical Documentation.
* Esperienza nel coordinamento di team e nella collaborazione all’interno di organizzazioni multinazionali.

**Competenze**

* Conoscenza approfondita del quadro normativo europeo applicabile ai dispositivi IVD.
* Capacità di orientarsi in contesti regolatori complessi.
* Regulatory advocacy e gestione delle relazioni con stakeholder esterni.
* Capacità di coordinamento e allineamento cross\-funzionale.
* Gestione della documentazione regolatoria.
* Forti capacità analitiche, comunicative e decisionali.
* Orientamento ai risultati.
* Capacità di promuovere una cultura collaborativa e orientata alle soluzioni.

**Costituiscono un plus**

* Esperienza in attività di regulatory advocacy o nella partecipazione a gruppi di lavoro e associazioni di settore.
* Certificazione RAC o equivalente.
* Conoscenza di framework regolatori internazionali, tra cui IMDRF e normative di Regno Unito, Svizzera e Stati Uniti.

**Sede e modalità di lavoro**


È prevista una disponibilità a trasferte fino al 20% del tempo lavorativo.

  


#### **What we offer**


**Cosa offriamo**

* **Retribuzione Annua Lorda a partire da €70\.000,** con possibilità di riconoscimento di un trattamento economico superiore per candidature che presentino competenze ed esperienze particolarmente in linea con il ruolo. È inoltre previsto un bonus variabile pari al 10% della RAL.
* Inquadramento **QUADRO CCNL Metalmeccanico.**
* Welfare aziendale e copertura sanitaria integrativa.

**Crescita e sviluppo**


Investiamo nella crescita delle nostre persone attraverso formazione continua, mentoring, coaching, una piattaforma e\-learning dedicata e l’accesso a LinkedIn Learning.

**Benessere e supporto alla persona**


Mettiamo a disposizione programmi dedicati al benessere personale e familiare, con servizi di supporto in ambito salute, nutrizione, genitorialità e benessere psicologico.


Crediamo che le persone possano esprimere il proprio potenziale al meglio quando trovano il giusto equilibrio tra vita professionale e personale. Per questo promuoviamo politiche di smart working e un ambiente attento alle esigenze individuali e familiari.

**Ambiente di lavoro**


Entrerai a far parte di un contesto internazionale, innovativo e collaborativo, lavorando con team multidisciplinari altamente qualificati e con interlocutori provenienti da diverse realtà europee.

**Perché Werfen**


Perché qui il tuo lavoro ha un impatto concreto.


In questo ruolo contribuirai a garantire che le nostre soluzioni diagnostiche possano essere introdotte e mantenute sul mercato europeo nel rispetto dei più elevati standard regolatori, supportando professionisti sanitari e laboratori nella loro missione di migliorare la qualità della diagnosi e della cura.


Se vuoi mettere la tua esperienza regolatoria al servizio dell’innovazione diagnostica e contribuire attivamente all’evoluzione del settore IVD in Europa, ti aspettiamo in Werfen.

  

Se sei interessato a un apprendimento continuo e ad essere sfidato ogni giorno, ti invitiamo a presentare il tuo curriculum.


Werfen apprezza e riconosce il valore della diversità. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Responsibility for quality, timelines, and outcomes is embraced by you, even in challenging situations, ensuring consistent and reliable performance

description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Are you passionate about advancing healthcare professional education and helping clinical teams deliver better outcomes for patients with aortic disease? Join Medtronic's Aortic business as a Training \& Education Specialist supporting the Mediterranean Cluster (Italy, Greece, Israel). You will help design, coordinate and execute educational initiatives that enable healthcare professionals to build endovascular knowledge, procedural confidence and effective team\-based practice.
  

  

This hybrid role combines regional program coordination with field\-based execution across the Mediterranean Cluster as well as on Western European level. You will collaborate with country commercial teams, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Compliance and regional Medical Education colleagues, as well as external faculty and training centers. Regular travel is required to support customer education events, hands\-on workshops, congress activities and strategic initiatives. The role is part of the Aortic Training \& Education organization; the formal reporting location and travel expectation will be confirmed during recruitment.

· Coordinate and deliver healthcare professional education programs, workshops, fellowships, webinars and blended learning activities across the Mediterranean Cluster and Western Europe


· Manage end\-to\-end program preparation, including needs assessment, project planning, faculty coordination, participant communication, logistics, materials, compliance documentation and post\-event follow\-up


· Partner with Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs and Compliance to ensure educational activities address customer needs and align with business, quality and regulatory requirements


· Build productive relationships with healthcare professionals, external faculty, training centers and internal stakeholders across different countries and cultures


· Support education related to Medtronic aortic therapies, including the Endurant™ Stent Graft System, a minimally invasive endovascular device used in the treatment of abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) and ValiantTM thoracic stent graft with CaptiviaTM delivery system.


· Monitor participation, feedback, learning outcomes and program execution data, and translate insights into practical improvements for future activities


· Contribute to regional congress activities, educational content development, budget tracking and strategic Medical Education projects  



**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

· Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare, biomedical engineering, education, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience


· Experience in medical education, clinical education, professional training, healthcare event management or a comparable customer\-facing role


· Demonstrated project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple programs, stakeholders and deadlines


· Clear written and verbal communication skills in Italian and English; confidence working across countries and cultures


· Experience working with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and an understanding of compliance requirements for healthcare professional engagement


· Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the Mediterranean Cluster (and occasionally in Western Europe), together with proficiency in Microsoft 365 and digital collaboration tools

title: Expert Multichannel Specialist Pharmacy
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**Job Purpose**

The Expert Multichannel Specialist Pharmacy is responsible for the implementation and development of digital and multichannel activities targeting the Pharmacy audience.


As part of the Expert Pharmacy Team, this role supports the execution of the digital strategy by ensuring the effective implementation of content, engagement tools, and educational initiatives, contributing to the growth of the professional pharmacy community and the achievement of business objectives.


The role also provides operational support to the Expert VMS Pharmacy area, collaborating on the implementation of initiatives dedicated to pharmacy professionals.


Reporting to the Expert Pharmacy Manager, this position works closely with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Commercial Excellence, Medical, Regulatory and external agencies.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Multichannel Engagement**

* Support the development and implementation of the Expert Pharmacy digital strategy.
* Coordinate and execute multichannel engagement activities to increase participation and interaction among pharmacists.
* Support the evolution of the Haleon HealthPartner platform and educational initiatives aimed at pharmacy professionals.
* Manage the implementation of webinars, e\-learning programs, and other digital initiatives, ensuring an effective engagement plan throughout the year.
* Coordinate operational activities related to the distribution of materials and samples requested through the portal.

**Project Management**

* Manage digital and multichannel projects from planning through execution, ensuring delivery against timelines and quality standards.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the effective implementation of planned activities.
* Coordinate agencies and vendors involved in the development of digital projects and activation programs.

**Data \& Performance Management**

* Monitor KPIs and performance metrics related to digital and multichannel activities.
* Prepare regular reports and analyze data to identify insights and optimization opportunities.
* Support CRM management activities, contributing to improved customer understanding and engagement effectiveness.
* Ensure data accuracy and quality across Pharmacy\-related activities and platforms.

**Support to Expert VMS Pharmacy**

* Provide operational support in the implementation of Expert VMS initiatives within the Pharmacy channel.
* Collaborate in the management and coordination of digital and educational initiatives dedicated to the VMS area.
* Support the creation, deployment, and distribution of content and materials for pharmacy professionals.

**Why You?**

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* University degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* Previous experience in marketing, digital marketing, multichannel engagement, or project management roles.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate complex activities.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work effectively within cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in KPI monitoring, CRM management, and performance data analysis.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Proactive mindset with a strong focus on identifying new opportunities.
* Results\-oriented approach and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent analytical capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork skills.
* Flexibility and ability to operate in dynamic and complex environments.
High level of accuracy, reliability, and ownership.  
*

title: CSA Lead
description:
**DATA4'S MISSION**



DATA4 creates Smart \& Scalable digital facilities for our customers. Our network of highly connected, resilient and sustainable data center campuses underpins our customers’ digital growth in Europe.



DATA4 Group finances, designs, constructs and operates its own data centers. Delivered through our data center campus model, we provide our customers with secure, scalable and high\-performance data hosting solutions.

  


**DATA4 VALUES**



At DATA4 we are driven by our values. These are the core of everything we do – from the proactivity we show in delivering great outcomes for our clients, to the responsibility we show as a key contributor to the digital economy. Our three values are:



* **To be entrepreneurial** – we are teams of doers who make things happen \- with autonomy, energy and a sense of responsibility


* **To always take responsibility** – for our impact on the people we work with, the society we are part of, and the environment in which we operate


* **To constantly be adaptable** – our business is designed to adapt, answering not only today’s challenges, but also anticipating what’s coming next.
  


**ABOUT THE ROLE**



We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Center Civils, Structural and Architectural (CSA) Lead to join our Engineering department. This transversal role focuses on leading all CSA aspects of data center design and construction projects. You will provide technical expertise, develop conceptual designs, oversee handover processes, represent the company in project meetings, and ensure the smooth implementation of CSA. The role will also focus on developing Global CSA standards and ensuring these are implemented on projects. This will also involve significant amount of work with Key internal and external stakeholders (including Clients) to develop CSA solutions.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Design Leadership \& Product Ownership**

  

* Act as the discipline owner for CSA engineering within the Engineering organisation.
* Lead the development and continuous improvement of DATA4 CSA design standards across all European campuses.
* Define and maintain design principles, technical specifications, standard details and approved solutions for data centre developments.
* Provide technical leadership during feasibility studies, due diligence activities and campus master planning exercises.
* Support the development of scalable and repeatable data centre products while driving consistency across projects and geographies.
* Ensure CSA designs align with operational, commercial, sustainability and customer requirements.

  


**Conceptual \& Detailed Design**


* Lead CSA design development for new campuses, expansions and retrofit projects.
* Review and approve conceptual, schematic, developed and detailed designs prepared by external consultants.
* Ensure designs achieve the required levels of resilience, safety, functionality, flexibility and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate structural systems, building envelopes, site development strategies, road networks, utilities interfaces and underground infrastructure.
* Coordinate interfaces between architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, controls and commissioning disciplines.

  


**Technical Governance \& Assurance**


* Serve as the company's internal expert for all CSA engineering matters.
* Establish and manage design governance processes, technical reviews and design assurance activities.
* Review consultant submissions and verify compliance with company standards, project requirements and applicable regulations.
* Ensure consistency of engineering solutions across multiple projects and countries.
* Support risk identification, mitigation and resolution related to CSA systems.

  


**Construction \& Project Support**


* Provide technical support during construction activities across multiple projects.
* Support project teams in resolving complex design, site and construction challenges.
* Review contractor proposals, value engineering initiatives and technical deviations.
* Participate in site inspections, quality audits and progress reviews.

  


**Stakeholder Management \& Representation**


* Act as the primary CSA engineering representative within the organisation.
* Collaborate with internal departments including Development, Construction, Operations, Procurement, Sustainability and Commercial teams.
* Manage relationships with external engineering consultants, architects, contractors and specialist suppliers.
* Represent DATA4 during technical meetings, design workshops, regulatory discussions and customer engagements.
* Communicate complex technical matters clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

  


**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**


* Monitor industry trends, technologies, materials and construction methodologies relevant to data centre development.
* Identify opportunities to optimise cost, programme, sustainability, scalability and operational performance.
* Lead the implementation of innovative design approaches and best practices.
* Analyse project feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve standards and processes.
* Contribute to sustainability initiatives, embodied carbon reduction strategies and circular economy objectives.

  


**RESPONSIBILITES IN TERMS OF IMS CERTIFICATIONS**


**Respect and enforce certification policies in terms of:**


* **H\&S:** Respect and enforce health and safety rules.
* **Environment:** Respect and enforce environmental policies.
* **Information security:** Respect and enforce information security policies
* **Energy:** Respect and enforce the policy of reducing energy consumption.

  


**REQUIREMENTS**


**Education and experience**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in design and construction of mission\-critical facilities, large industrial developments, commercial developments or data centres.
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and managing external consultants.
* Demonstrated experience in CSA design governance and technical assurance.
* Experience supporting projects throughout the full development and construction lifecycle.
* English: Fluent.

  


**Technical skills**


* Strong experience in architectural design, building planning and building envelope systems.
* Strong knowledge of structural and civil engineering
* Understanding of geotechnical engineering principles and site development constraints.
* Knowledge of European building codes, structural standards and construction regulations.
* Experience with multidisciplinary coordination within mission\-critical facilities.
* Experience reviewing engineering consultant deliverables and managing design reviews.
* Knowledge of BIM methodologies and digital design coordination processes.
* Understanding of sustainability principles and low\-carbon construction strategies.
* Experience supporting construction activities and resolving field engineering issues.

  


**Preferred**:


* Chartered Engineer (CEng), Chartered Structural Engineer (MIStructE) or equivalent professional accreditation.
* Registered Architect or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience in hyperscale or colocation data centre developments.
* Experience in design standardisation and product development.
* Experience with BIM, Revit and common design collaboration platforms.

  


**Soft skills**


* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proactive: Takes initiative and ownership of tasks without needing constant direction.
* Accountable: Admits mistakes, learns from them, and delivers on commitments.
* Agile: Learns quickly and applies new knowledge in practical situations.
* Collaborative: Works effectively with diverse teams and adapts communication styles accordingly.
* Resilient: Maintains a positive attitude and composure under pressure.
* Independent: Works autonomously and takes calculated risks.
* Data\-driven: Makes decisions based on evidence and analysis.

title: GMP Compliance Specialist
description:
Il nostro Business
  
Adare Pharma Solutions è un’organizzazione globale di sviluppo e produzione conto terzi (CDMO), con sedi in Nord America e in Italia. Offriamo un ampio ventaglio di servizi di produzione, confezionamento e di ricerca e sviluppo. I nostri clienti spaziano da aziende biotech in espansione impegnate nello sviluppo di studi clinici innovativi, fino a società farmaceutiche consolidate che producono grandi volumi di medicinali approvati e ampiamente utilizzati.
  
Attraverso talenti di alto livello provenienti dal settore life science da un lato e tecnologie moderne di sviluppo e produzione dall’altro, Adare consente ai clienti di fornire farmaci potenzialmente salvavita in forme più facilmente somministrabili, in particolare per pazienti quali neonati e anziani. Questo è il significato di “Trasformare la somministrazione di farmaci – trasformare le vite.”
  
La nostra Cultura
  
Anche se lavoriamo in paesi diversi e proveniamo da contesti diversi, noi dipendenti di Adare collaboriamo per uno scopo comune. Essere dipendenti di Adare significa collaborare insieme verso uno scopo comune, pur lavorando in paesi diversi e provenendo da contesti diversi. Supportati da una leadership di riconosciuta esperienza nel settore, stiamo tracciando la strada verso un futuro più luminoso, attirando i migliori talenti all'interno e oltre il settore CDMO. Nel fornire risultati di alta qualità ai nostri clienti esterni, promuoviamo internamente una cultura collaborativa e orientata al cliente, in cui i dipendenti si supportano a vicenda, condividono conoscenze e si incoraggiano reciprocamente a dare il meglio ogni giorno.
  
Perché scegliere Adare?
  
Adare è un’azienda di proprietà di fondi di private equity ed è proiettata verso una crescita esponenziale. Ai dipendenti vengono offerte opportunità di sviluppo professionale per avanzare all’interno dell’organizzazione, rafforzando le proprie competenze professionali e la conoscenza del settore grazie all’investimento di Adare nella loro crescita.
  
Sono presenti diverse aree in cui intraprendere una carriera, quali produzione, ingegneria, qualità, CQ, ricerca \& sviluppo, amministrazione e finanza, supply chain, commerciale, marketing, project management, risorse umane e salute, sicurezza e ambiente (HSE).
  
Il nostro pacchetto di benefit è competitivo e include assicurazione sanitaria, piano pensionistico, premio di partecipazione e altri benefit previsti da accordo interno.
  
  

Posizione
  
Siamo alla ricerca di un/una GMP Compliance Specialist che si unisca al nostro Production Team.
  
**CCNL di riferimento:** industria chimico\-farmaceutica
  
Assunzione a tempo indeterminato
  
RAL a partire da euro 32\.364,78
  
Categoria e posizione organizzativa min. D2
  
  

Sede di lavoro
  
Pessano con Bornago
  
  

Descrizione
  
Il/la GMP Compliance Specialist risponde al Direttore della Produzione – Director I, Production PES and Industrialization, ed in collaborazione con le altre funzioni di GMP Compliance e di Production Supervisor si occupa di garantire il rispetto e la corretta applicazione delle norme GMP all’interno del reparto di produzione. title: Market Associate
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

***Please note this is a hybrid position from our Milan office.***


**The Community you will join:**



Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Associate, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimization of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. These hosts are individuals who manage their own property or support owners by hosting on their behalf. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimize their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb.


**The difference you will make:**



As a Market Associate, you will be responsible for the retention and growth of long\-tail Hosts in an assigned territory. You will establish and nurture business relationships with emerging entrepreneurs by suggesting and supporting strategic initiatives that drive their success on Airbnb. These initiatives will include supply optimization, pricing optimization, host recruitment, and platform education. In addition, as these Hosts successfully grow on the platform, it will be essential that you support them in delivering authentic, high\-quality hosting that creates memorable guest experiences. Beyond one\-to\-one account management responsibilities, you'll also support Market Managers on your team to deliver one\-to\-many education programs, such as webinars and scaled e\-mail communication. Ultimately, this team will be responsible for helping long\-tail Hosts thrive on Airbnb.


**A typical day:**


* Manage a book of business consisting of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimization on Airbnb.
* Conduct one\-on\-one optimization and onboarding conversations, providing strategic recommendations on pricing, availability, and listing quality.
* Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximize their revenue potential.
* Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams.
* Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high\-quality support to improve their experience on the platform.
* Analyze performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success.
* Develop long\-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs.


**Your expertise:**


* 3\+ years of experience in new sales, account management, or partner support.
* 2\+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have).
* Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively.
* Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management.
* Highly goal\-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in\-person.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus).
* **Fluency in Italian \& English.**


**Our Commitment To Inclusion \& Belonging:**



Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively\-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

  

**Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.


**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work\-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: VP of Technology & Product
description:
From day one at Unobravo, we’ve been **on a mission to make mental health support truly accessible to everyone** by normalizing therapy, fostering openness, and breaking down the stigma that still surrounds it.  

Our success is driven by an exceptional team dedicated to providing high\-quality, accessible care, anytime, anywhere. With over 9,500 qualified therapists and more than 10 million therapy sessions delivered, **we’re proud to have made a meaningful difference in countless lives.**


To take our company to the next level, we're looking for a **VP of Technology \& Product** to lead the next chapter of our Technology \& Product organisation.


We're looking for a **technically credible, product\-minded leader** who combines strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and leads with **trust, strong leadership and low ego**.

**Reporting to the COO**, you'll lead **Engineering, Product and Design** across an organisation of \~**50 people**, bringing these disciplines together around a shared strategy while empowering their respective leaders.


You'll also play a **key role in driving Unobravo's responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies**, identifying opportunities to create meaningful value while ensuring innovation remains grounded in **clinical integrity, user trust, safety and regulatory requirements**.


Unobravo is first and foremost a **mental health company**. Technology enables our mission; this role will ensure Product and Technology can deliver it **responsibly and at scale**.

### **The Essentials**

* **Preferred Location:** Milan\-based. As a senior leadership role, we expect regular in\-person presence in our Milan office (2/3 days/week) recognising the value of face\-to\-face collaboration at this level.
* **Salary range:** Starting from €100,000 gross annual base salary, with the final package determined based on experience and scope, in line with our commitment to transparent and equitable compensation practices.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategy \& Prioritisation**: Driving an integrated technology strategy that serves both patients and therapists, translates company priorities into clear direction and roadmaps and balances user needs, clinical impact, business value, scalability and long\-term sustainability.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership**: Creating the conditions for Engineering, Product and Design to operate as a cohesive, outcome\-oriented organisation.
* **Executive Communication \& Influence**: Representing Technology and Product at leadership level, translating complex trade\-offs, constraints and risks into clear business implications and advocating for the investments needed to support the company over the long term.
* **Technology Scalability \& Reliability**: Ensuring Unobravo operates a scalable, secure and reliable technology platform capable of supporting our long\-term ambitions.
* **Pragmatic Engineering Culture**: Fostering a pragmatic engineering culture that values simplicity, maintainability and impact over unnecessary complexity or hype\-driven technology decisions.
* **Technical Sustainability**: Balancing speed and innovation with technical sustainability, including the effective management of technical debt, architecture and platform evolution.
* **AI Strategy \& Governance**: Shaping and championing the organisation’s AI strategy and culture, influencing how teams adopt, experiment with and embed AI into their ways of working, while establishing appropriate governance and ensuring alignment with clinical, ethical, security and regulatory standards.
* **Leadership \& Talent Development**: Leading, coaching and developing senior leaders across Engineering, Product and Design, creating strong functional leadership while fostering collaboration across disciplines.
* **Low\-Ego Culture \& Ownership**: Building a low\-ego culture where teams have meaningful ownership, people can challenge decisions openly and the best ideas win regardless of hierarchy.
* **Customer\-Centred Delivery**: Ensuring teams deliver meaningful value through customer insight, experimentation, data\-informed iteration and high\-quality execution.

### **️ YOU WILL BE THE PERFECT FIT IF YOU HAVE:**

### **Technology \& Product Leadership**

* Significant **leadership experience within Engineering or Technology**, with meaningful responsibility for Product and cross\-functional product development organisations.
* A **strong technical foundation** and credibility, with the ability to **understand architecture, challenge technical decisions** and evaluate technology trade\-offs without undermining team ownership.
* Strong **product judgement** and the ability to balance customer value, business priorities, engineering sustainability and speed of execution.
* A track record of **delivering successful digital products** and **scaling technology organisations** in high\-growth environments.
* Experience in **regulated or highly trust\-sensitive environments** such as healthcare, fintech or other data\-sensitive platforms is highly valued.

### **Organisational \& People Leadership**

* Proven experience **leading and developing leaders**, building high\-performing teams and evolving organisations as they scale.
* A l**ow\-ego leadership style** characterised by intellectual humility, curiosity, direct communication and a genuine commitment to **enabling others to succeed**.
* The ability to **create clarity and accountability** while giving leaders and teams meaningful autonomy.

### **Business \& Executive Leadership**

* Strong **business acumen** and the ability to connect **Technology** and **Product** decisions to broader company outcomes.
* Demonstrated **ability to influence senior stakeholders**, communicate complexity simply and advocate for **long\-term technology needs** in business terms.
* The confidence to **challenge decisions** constructively and stand behind Product and Technology needs when they serve the company's long\-term interests.
* Strong **strategic thinking** combined with the **pragmatism** to know when good enough is better than perfect.

### **AI \& Responsible Innovation**

* Strong u**nderstanding of AI** and **emerging technologies** and the ability to identify where they can create **meaningful value** for users and the business.
* Experience navigating the **ethical, security, governance or regulatory considerations** associated with technology and AI adoption.
* A **thoughtful approach** to innovation that balances opportunity with **Unobravo's responsibility towards patients, therapists and their data.**

### **Power\-Ups**

* Experience leading or partnering closely with **Design** and **Research** functions.
* Experience operating in a **European regulatory environment**.
* Experience **scaling** organisations across **multiple markets.**

***Not everyone checks every box, and that’s okay. If this role inspires you and you’re passionate about making an impact in our mission, we’d love to hear from you***

### **What we offer**

 **Scaling with purpose**  

Step into a work environment that's in **constant motion**, and **ever\-evolving**. Be part of a company that's on the rise!  

  

**Everyone Needs Unobravo**  

Your mental health matters. Get access to **exclusive discounts on psychotherapy sessions** with our professionals: your well\-being comes first.

 **Moments That Matter**  

Enjoy unforgettable**company retreats**,**team\-building**experiences, nationwide **aperitivo parties**and more.. Because we love celebrating milestones together!

 **Free Online Language Training ️**  

We speak your language, and want you to speak ours! Enjoy a **free membership and conversation courses** on our language platform to grow personally and professionally.

**Birthday Off**  

Celebrating the passing of time is also fun at Unobravo! All employees can enjoy a **day off** on the month of their **birthday**.

 **World Mental Health Day, Our Way ‍️**  

On World Mental Health Day, we step back together, giving each of us **an additional day off** to rest, reflect and recharge.

 **Inclusive Parental Leave**  

Enjoy **extra days off** to celebrate the arrival of your little ones. Available for **all parents**, including biological fathers, same\-sex parents, adoptive, and foster parents. Because every family deserves time to connect.

### **To Fit in Our Culture**

  

At Unobravo, what truly connects us isn’t just *what* we do — it’s *how* we do it.  

If you’re curious to discover the values and behaviors that guide us every day, take a look at our **Culture Page** and see what being part of Unobravo really means.

### **Come as you are**

  

At Unobravo, everyone is welcome. We value individuality and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.  

We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and to provide reasonable accommodations to ensure a fair and accessible hiring process for all.  

If you require any support or adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to make sure you have a positive experience.

### **️ Selection Process**

  

Every application is carefully reviewed by our Talent team. If your profile matches the role, we’ll reach out to schedule an introductory call.  

Our selection journey may vary depending on the position, but it’s always designed to be clear, engaging, and meaningful. You might be invited to complete a case study and will meet your future manager and key team members along the way, so you can get a real sense of what it’s like to work with us, because finding the right fit goes both ways.  

And don’t worry! You’ll always have a dedicated point of contact from our Talent team to guide you through each step and make sure you have the best possible experience.

title: SDR
description:

Crediamo che il commercio locale sia il cuore pulsante delle nostre comunità e siamo qui per offrire ai commercianti gli strumenti e il supporto che meritano per competere con i grandi player.


Mentre continuiamo a crescere, stiamo espandendo il nostro team di field sales e siamo alla ricerca di candidati motivati, orientati alle persone e focalizzati sui risultati che vogliano unirsi alla nostra operatività. Se ti piace entrare in contatto con le persone, prosperi in un ambiente dinamico e frenetico e vuoi crescere in un'azienda che sta rivoluzionando i pagamenti locali, questo è il posto che fa per te!

 **La nostra Cultura:**


Questi cinque valori definiscono il nostro modo di lavorare ogni giorno:

* **Orgogliosi di servire:** Siamo al fianco delle piccole e locali imprese.
* **Costruire dal futuro:** Creiamo oggi ciò che verrà domani.
* **Semplicità:** Diamo valore alla chiarezza, all'efficienza e alla tecnologia intelligente.
* **Mentalità vincente:** Puntiamo in alto e offriamo l'eccellenza.
* **Un Sogno. Una Squadra. Una Voce:** La collaborazione ci rende più forti.

  

**Le tue Responsabilità:**
--------------------------

* Lavora attraverso una coda prioritaria di lead valutati in base al profilo e all'intenzione, stabilendo il primo contatto principalmente per telefono, utilizzando email e social media come canali supplementari.
* Qualifica ogni lead rispetto a una serie chiara di criteri: questa azienda rientra nel profilo giusto ed è il momento giusto per parlare?
* Pianifica gli incontri con i commercianti qualificati direttamente sul calendario di un rappresentante di Vendite sul Campo (*Field Sales*) con almeno 48 ore di preavviso, garantendo la partecipazione tramite una conferma e un promemoria il giorno prima.
* Segnala i lead che mostrano potenziale ma che devono essere contattati in un momento più appropriato.
* Chiudi i lead che non rientrano nel profilo adeguato, registrando una motivazione chiara e onesta.
* Mantieni il CRM organizzato: registri accurati, note chiare e stati aggiornati. La persona successiva nel processo dipende dalle informazioni che registri.

**Il tuo Profilo:**
-------------------

* Disinvoltura al telefono e capacità di intrattenere una conversazione approfondita e utile con il titolare di un'azienda che non si aspettava la tua chiamata.
* La capacità di ascoltare più che presentare, riconoscendo la differenza tra una vera opportunità e un semplice "forse".
* Organizzazione e costanza: gestisci la lista, effettui i follow\-up puntualmente e mantieni i tuoi registri aggiornati.
* La capacità di gestire un "no" con naturalezza e di mantenere un'energia costante per un'intera giornata di chiamate.
* Padronanza nell'uso di un CRM e di strumenti di vendita moderni, o la capacità di imparare rapidamente a usare nuovi strumenti.
* Fluenza nella lingua Italiana.

**Cosa sarà apprezzato:**
-------------------------

* Esperienza nello sviluppo delle vendite o in un altro ruolo commerciale orientato agli obiettivi con una forte componente telefonica.
* L'esperienza nel settore fintech o nella vendita di soluzioni di pagamento costituirà un vantaggio.
* Esperienza con un CRM.

**Come si misura il successo:**
-------------------------------

* Incontri qualificati fissati e, soprattutto, incontri tenuti e riconosciuti dal venditore come opportunità rilevanti.
* Qualità della qualificazione: le opportunità che passi al team si trasformano in veri colloqui di affari, piuttosto che in incontri senza potenziale.
* Un flusso costante e affidabile di lead ben qualificati, settimana dopo settimana.

**Perché unirti a Teya?:**
--------------------------

* Il ruolo di SDR è il banco di prova in cui si forgiano i grandi venditori. Imparerai il mercato, il prodotto e l'arte della qualificazione fin dal primo giorno, mantenendo il riconoscimento per il tuo contributo a ogni accordo che contribuisci ad avviare.
* Gli SDR con le prestazioni migliori hanno l'opportunità di passare a ruoli di *Field Sales*, assumendo progressivamente maggiore responsabilità nel processo di vendita.
* L'operatività è progettata per aiutarti a raggiungere il successo. I lead arrivano già identificati, arricchiti e valutati, permettendoti di concentrare i tuoi sforzi sulle conversazioni che contano davvero, invece di perdere tempo a cercare dati.
* Avrai a disposizione un quadro di qualificazione chiaro, strumenti moderni e un team che valuta il tuo lavoro in base alla qualità delle opportunità che crei, anziché solo sul volume dei contatti effettuati.

**Cosa ti offriamo:**
---------------------

* Stipendio base lordo competitivo fino a €25\.000 \+ €10 000 variable. (in base a l'esperienza)
* Contratto a tempo determinato 6 mesi.
* Welfare aziendale (142 € netti al mese).
* Buoni pasto da 8 € netti al giorno con Coverflex.
* 25 giorni di ferie annuali (oltre alle festività locali).
* Lavora con alcune delle migliori menti del settore che stanno cambiando il volto del Fintech in Italia!


Pronto a essere il volto della rivoluzione Fintech in Italia? Se hai la grinta per vendere e la passione per il servizio, vogliamo costruire il futuro insieme a te. Facciamo la differenza, insieme!

  

Teya è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità.


Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo in cui chiunque, indipendentemente da razza, etnia, identità o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, disabilità, religione o background, possa prosperare e dare il meglio di sé. Crediamo che un team diversificato porti a idee migliori, risultati più solidi e un ambiente di lavoro più accogliente per tutti.


Se hai bisogno di qualsiasi adattamento ragionevole in qualsiasi fase del processo di selezione – che si tratti di colloqui, valutazioni o altre parti della candidatura – ti invitiamo a comunicarcelo. Ci impegniamo a garantire che ogni candidato viva un'esperienza equa e accessibile con noi.

title: HSE Specialist
description:
Responsabilità del ruolo

L’**E\&HS Specialist** è responsabile di garantire la conformità dell’organizzazione alla normativa vigente in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente, con particolare riferimento al **D.Lgs. 81/08** e al **D.Lgs. 152/06**, assicurando al contempo l’applicazione degli standard e delle procedure aziendali.

La figura opera a stretto contatto con i dipartimenti di **Produzione, Manutenzione e Quality Assurance (QA)**, supportando l’implementazione e il monitoraggio delle procedure operative in un ambiente altamente regolamentato.

Avrà inoltre un ruolo attivo nella promozione della cultura della prevenzione, nella gestione dei rischi HSE e nel miglioramento continuo degli standard di salute, sicurezza e tutela ambientale.

Ambiente e Rischio di Incidente Rilevante

* **Gestione delle emissioni e degli scarichi:** monitorare il rispetto delle autorizzazioni ambientali, inclusa l’Autorizzazione Unica Ambientale (AUA), supervisionando i controlli analitici relativi alle emissioni in atmosfera e agli scarichi idrici.
* **Gestione dei rifiuti:** garantire la corretta classificazione dei rifiuti secondo i codici EER, nonché le attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e smaltimento dei rifiuti speciali e pericolosi derivanti dai processi produttivi farmaceutici.
* **Rischio di incidente rilevante:** supportare la gestione e il monitoraggio degli aspetti HSE connessi alla presenza e alla gestione di sostanze pericolose, in coordinamento con le funzioni aziendali e i consulenti di riferimento.

Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro – D.Lgs. 81/08

* **Valutazione dei rischi:** collaborare con il consulente esterno nell’aggiornamento del DVR e delle valutazioni dei rischi specifici, tra cui rischio chimico e biologico, ATEX, movimentazione dei carichi e rumore.
* **Supporto operativo:** elaborare e aggiornare procedure operative e SOP HSE, assicurandone l’integrazione con le procedure e gli standard GMP applicabili allo stabilimento.
* **Infortuni e Near Miss:** gestire il processo di registrazione, analisi e reportistica degli infortuni, degli incidenti e dei near miss, contribuendo all’individuazione delle azioni correttive e preventive.
* **Permessi di lavoro:** gestire e verificare i sistemi di Work Permit per attività ad alto rischio, quali lavori in quota, lavori in spazi confinati, lavori a caldo e interventi su linee o impianti contenenti sostanze chimiche.
* **Gestione delle ditte esterne:** coordinare e monitorare gli aspetti HSE relativi alle imprese appaltatrici, con particolare riferimento agli adempimenti previsti dall’art. 26 e dal Titolo IV del D.Lgs. 81/08\.

Formazione e Sorveglianza Sanitaria

* **Piani formativi:** contribuire alla definizione e alla pianificazione dei corsi di formazione obbligatori e specifici in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente, con particolare attenzione alla gestione delle sostanze pericolose e delle emergenze.
* **Formazione HSE:** gestire il processo di onboarding e di formazione HSE del personale neoassunto, degli interinali e delle ditte esterne operanti presso lo stabilimento.
* **Gestione appalti:** supportare la gestione della documentazione HSE relativa alle imprese terze, inclusi DUVRI, qualificazione e verifica dei requisiti delle ditte appaltatrici.
* **Sorveglianza sanitaria:** interfacciarsi con il Medico Competente e con le funzioni aziendali coinvolte per gli aspetti di salute e sicurezza connessi alle attività lavorative.

Sistemi di Gestione e Audit

* **Sistemi di gestione:** applicare e supportare il mantenimento dei sistemi di gestione conformi agli standard **ISO 14001 – Ambiente** e **ISO 45001 – Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro**.
* **Audit e verifiche ispettive:** partecipare, a supporto del team HSE, agli audit interni e alle verifiche da parte degli enti e delle autorità competenti, quali **ASL, ARPA e Vigili del Fuoco**.
* **Miglioramento continuo:** contribuire all’identificazione di opportunità di miglioramento e all’implementazione di azioni correttive e preventive per il continuo miglioramento delle performance HSE.

Requisiti e competenze

**Formazione**

* Laurea in **Ingegneria Ambientale, Ingegneria della Sicurezza** o discipline scientifiche/tecniche affini.
* Costituisce titolo preferenziale una formazione specifica come **ASPP/RSPP**, con possesso dei relativi moduli formativi previsti dalla normativa vigente.
* Costituisce titolo preferenziale la formazione in materia di **GMP, gestione delle emergenze, ATEX e rischio chimico/biologico**.

**Esperienza professionale**

* **2–5 anni di esperienza** maturata in ambito HSE, preferibilmente all’interno di aziende farmaceutiche, chimiche, manifatturiere o comunque caratterizzate da contesti produttivi altamente regolamentati.
* Esperienza nella gestione degli aspetti di **salute, sicurezza e ambiente** e nella collaborazione con consulenti, enti esterni e funzioni aziendali.
* Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza nella gestione di **audit, autorizzazioni ambientali, DVR, permessi di lavoro e imprese appaltatrici**.

**Competenze tecniche**

* Conoscenza della normativa italiana in materia di **Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente**, con particolare riferimento al D.Lgs. 81/08 e al D.Lgs. 152/06\.
* Conoscenza dei principali strumenti e metodologie di **risk assessment** e gestione dei rischi HSE.
* Conoscenza dei processi di gestione di **infortuni, near miss, non conformità e azioni correttive/preventive**.
* Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione **ISO 14001 e ISO 45001**.
* Familiarità con procedure e requisiti **GMP**, preferibilmente maturata in ambiente farmaceutico.
* Conoscenza delle procedure relative alla gestione delle **ditte esterne, DUVRI, Titolo IV e art. 26 del D.Lgs. 81/08**.
* Buona conoscenza degli strumenti informatici e del pacchetto **Microsoft Office**.
* **Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese**, sia scritta sia parlata.

**Competenze personali**

* Ottime capacità **comunicative e relazionali**, con attitudine a interfacciarsi con interlocutori a diversi livelli dell’organizzazione.
* **Proattività e autonomia** nella gestione delle attività e nell’individuazione delle criticità.
* Spiccate capacità di **problem solving** e di analisi delle situazioni di rischio.
* Capacità di **gestire le priorità** e lavorare efficacemente in un contesto dinamico e regolamentato.
* Attitudine al **lavoro in team** e alla collaborazione con Produzione, Manutenzione, QA e altre funzioni aziendali.
* Orientamento al **miglioramento continuo** e alla diffusione della cultura della prevenzione.
* Precisione, affidabilità e forte senso di **responsabilità e compliance**.
* Buone capacità di **coordinamento e gestione degli interlocutori esterni**, inclusi consulenti e imprese appaltatrici.

As a **Clinical Field Service Engineer**, you will support customers operating Waters LC\-MS systems within regulated clinical laboratory environments. No two days will be the same.  

As a global organisation, Waters offers a wide range of opportunities to learn, grow and develop. Many of our team members have progressed within Field Service or moved into other areas of the business, including applications support, sales, global technical support and leadership.

* Complete service records and other required documentation accurately and promptly, in accordance with Waters’ quality and regulatory procedures.

### **The Opportunity**

  

We are seeking an experienced Global Study Lead (GSL) to provide strategic and operational leadership for complex global clinical studies.

  

This is a senior study leadership position with end\-to\-end accountability for clinical study delivery, from study initiation through to study close\-out and archiving. You will define the operational strategy, lead cross\-functional study teams, and ensure studies are delivered to the required timelines, quality, budget and regulatory standards.

  

As a key member of the Study Leadership Team, you will represent Clinical Operations and work closely with Clinical, Statistics and other cross\-functional partners to drive decisions, manage risk and ensure successful study delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the operational strategy and end\-to\-end delivery of one or more global clinical studies.
* Own study timelines, budget, quality, risks and key operational deliverables.
* Provide strategic leadership to global, cross\-functional study teams and drive timely decision\-making.
* Represent Clinical Operations within the Study Leadership Team and act as the senior escalation point for operational issues.
* Translate clinical development and asset strategy into clear study\-level operational plans.
* Lead proactive study risk identification, mitigation and issue resolution.
* Ensure robust feasibility, study planning and operational execution.
* Provide strategic operational input into protocols, informed consent forms and other key study documents.
* Oversee CROs and other external vendors, including vendor selection, performance management and escalation where deliverables are at risk.
* Ensure studies remain compliant with ICH\-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and inspection\-readiness requirements.
* Lead study financial planning, forecasting and budget management.
* Communicate study progress, risks, decisions and recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Champion innovative approaches to clinical trial delivery, including decentralised trial approaches, technology, automation and AI\-enabled ways of working.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Clinical Operations.

### **About You**

  

You will be an accomplished clinical operations professional with significant experience leading complex global clinical studies within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

  

You will bring:

* A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience in global clinical study delivery, ideally across multiple phases, indications and geographic regions.
* Proven experience holding end\-to\-end accountability for complex global clinical trials.
* Strong experience leading global cross\-functional teams within a matrix environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of study timelines, budgets, risks, quality and operational strategy.
* Significant experience overseeing CROs and third\-party vendors, including performance management and issue resolution.
* In\-depth knowledge of ICH\-GCP, global regulatory requirements and clinical development processes.
* Strong project and financial management capabilities.
* The ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions in complex, fast\-paced environments.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and conflict\-management skills.
* Experience proactively identifying and resolving risks that could impact clinical programmes.

### **Highly Desirable**

  

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Phase II and/or Phase III global clinical trials.
* Adaptive or other innovative trial designs.
* Decentralised clinical trials (DCTs).
* Platform, umbrella or basket studies.
* Technology\-enabled clinical trial delivery, automation or AI/ML.
* Working with investigators, external experts and regulatory authorities.
* Broad therapeutic\-area experience, combined with deep expertise in one or more indications.

### **What Success Looks Like**


The successful Global Study Lead will be able to set the vision for study delivery, translate strategy into execution and bring diverse stakeholders together around clear priorities. You will be comfortable making complex decisions autonomously, challenging constructively, escalating when required and empowering teams to deliver in demanding global clinical\-development environments.
